training_source: FRED flooded roads (812 pairs) + 3 hand-seeded local urban photos (flip-augmented, oversampled), fine-tuned from the FRED checkpoint; location-disjoint val water IoU 0.7691
notes: Detects both reflective flood water and murky asphalt potholes on local photos; FRED val improved over the FRED-only model (0.6513 -> 0.7691). Base models kept: abcdwavenet_ponding.onnx (Puddle-1000), artifacts/onnx_fred (FRED-only).
seed_labels: waterwatch/seed_local_labels.py polygons are seed labels drawn after visual review; replace with reviewed labelme annotations as more local photos arrive
